propositions: Models fence-wrap quoted JSON and emit schema-valid decoys, defeating heuristic extraction; an explicit sentinel marker channel makes payload location a stated contract

The marker directive must be single-sourced as a module constant and included in both the first-attempt schema directive and the bounded-retry prompt to ensure consistent channel semantics across retry attempts

Marker extraction must recognize markers only when line-anchored (alone on their own line), pair them left-to-right by next-close rule, and iterate blocks in reverse-document-order to honor last-block-wins semantics
A reply with no complete marker blocks must fall back to full-reply schema-filtered selection byte-for-byte identical to today's behavior, ensuring markerless and legacy transcripts do not regress
A marker block containing invalid JSON or schema must fail-closed rather than fall through to select a schema-valid decoy outside the markers

The test harness and provider-parity tests must be updated in lockstep to single-source the entire directive string and correctly extract the schema portion, preserving the invariant that both prompted arms carry identical directives
